card.name: Before factor or antigen in clotting lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and', 'of' and the 'brand' in 'Willebrand' inside lists of clotting factor tests, right where 'factor' or 'antigen' could come next. Seen in desmopressin and clotting-lab text with factor VIII and von Willebrand.

modes.label: Separators in factor lists
modes.description: A comma or 'and' after a factor VIII or ristocetin activity measure, before the next factor or antigen item.
modes.example: assess serum sodium, bleeding time, factor VIII coagulant activity<<,>> r

modes.label: Inside von Willebrand
modes.description: The 'brand' piece of Willebrand just before 'antigen' or 'factor'.
modes.example: and von Wille<<brand>> antigen to ensure that adequate levels are being

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward 'factor' or 'antigen' (as in Factor VIII or antigen) and away from unrelated word starts.
card.plain: It fires in lists of clotting tests when the next word is likely to be 'factor' or 'antigen'.
